## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_deprecations.py:94-112` schedules three public removals: the Python-library `rebar.transition(force_close=...)` keyword, boolean `rebar.transition(force=True)`, and explicit hosted-OpenAI `openai-chat:` model selection. Closed migration `blusterous-earthly-kitten` established the temporary warning mappings; this ticket is the scheduled retirement, not a duplicate. These registry-adjacent removals are intentionally one pre-1.0 release increment: one compatibility deadline, one breaking-change notice, and separate subsystem-specific test coverage.

## End State

The Python library accepts only a reason-bearing string `force="<reason>"`. `force_close` or boolean `force=True` fail at the library boundary with `force="<reason>"` named as the replacement. Hosted model selection accepts `openai-responses:<model>`. Both live hosted-resolution paths reject explicit `openai-chat:`. Custom OpenAI-compatible `base_url` selection retains its Chat Completions dialect.

## Implementation Plan

1. Retire library mappings in `_lib_writes` plus `_deprecations`. Do not add an environment or configuration tombstone: these are callable inputs, so validation belongs at the Python boundary.
2. Regenerate the API snapshot plus MCP-library parity manifest after the library signature changes.
3. Retire hosted explicit `openai-chat:` in `_resolve_target` plus `_pai_model`/`_openai_wire_prefix`. Preserve custom-endpoint routing. Migrate hosted `gpt-5.4*` inventory to `openai-responses:`.
4. Retarget each test that currently preserves hosted `openai-chat:` to a hosted rejection assertion. Retain each custom-endpoint Chat assertion.
5. Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md` via `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`. Migrate all maintained hosted examples plus workflow-schema descriptions to `openai-responses:`.
6. Replace the two legacy warn-and-map tests in `test_force_unification_blusterous.py` with rejection tests. Retarget each behavior-preserving caller in `test_completion_gate.py`, `test_ac_checkbox_precheck_heldout.py`, `test_attestations_integration.py`, `test_plan_review_close_gate_lifecycle.py`, `test_attested_close_guard_e2e.py`, and `test_transition_open_children.py` to `force="<reason>"`.
7. Update maintained release/API guidance. Preserve historical `force_close_reason` durable state.

## File Impact

- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py` — retired library inputs
- `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`, `scripts/gen_api_surface.py` — generated public signature snapshot
- `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json`, `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` — retired library-only parity divergence
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py`, `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py`, `src/rebar/llm/config.py`, `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` — hosted resolution plus deployed model inventory
- `tests/unit/test_openai_responses_migration.py`, `test_pydantic_ai_runner.py`, `test_llm_capabilities.py`, `test_model_classes.py`, `test_openai_compatible_provider.py`, `test_provider_qualifier.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py` — hosted rejection plus custom-endpoint preservation
- `docs/config-reference.md`, `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py` — cfg-kind output
- `docs/llm-example-configs.md`, `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`, `docs/llm-framework.md`, `src/rebar/schemas/workflow.v1.schema.json`, `workflow.v2.schema.json`, `workflow.v3.schema.json` — maintained hosted examples
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_force_unification_blusterous.py`, `test_completion_gate.py`, `test_ac_checkbox_precheck_heldout.py`, `test_attestations_integration.py`, `test_plan_review_close_gate_lifecycle.py`, `test_attested_close_guard_e2e.py`, `test_transition_open_children.py` — rejection migration plus canonical callers
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md` — breaking-release guidance

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `rebar.transition(force_close="legacy")` is rejected at the Python-library boundary. Its error names `force="<explicit reason>"`.
- [x] `rebar.transition(force=True)` is rejected at the Python-library boundary. Its error names `force="<explicit reason>"`.
- [x] `rebar.transition(force="approved reason")` remains accepted.
- [x] `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json` is regenerated through `scripts/gen_api_surface.py`. Its `transition` signature has no `force_close` row.
- [x] `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` removes the retired `force_close` divergence.
- [x] `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` removes the retired `force_close` `library_params` entry.
- [x] `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` passes.
- [x] The CLI retains its existing retired-input rejection. This ticket adds no CLI force-close removal.
- [x] The MCP transition schema remains free of `force_close`. This ticket adds no MCP force-close removal.
- [x] Hosted `openai-chat:gpt-4o` is rejected through `_resolve_target`.
- [x] Hosted `openai-chat:gpt-4o` is rejected through `_pai_model`.
- [x] Hosted `openai-responses:gpt-4o` succeeds.
- [x] A custom endpoint retains Chat Completions routing.
- [x] Every listed resolver test distinguishes the rejected hosted case from the preserved custom-endpoint case.
- [x] Each hosted `gpt-5.4*` entry in `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` uses `openai-responses:`.
- [x] `scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check` passes with the retired hosted cfg row absent.
- [x] Each listed maintained document plus workflow schema replaces hosted `openai-chat:gpt-4o` with its Responses equivalent.
- [x] `test_force_unification_blusterous.py` has no warning-plus-mapping assertion for `force_close` or boolean `force`.
- [x] Every listed behavior-preserving lifecycle caller uses canonical `force="<reason>"`.
- [x] `rg -n -U "rebar\.transition\([\s\S]{0,500}?(force_close\s*=|force\s*=\s*True)" tests` has expected matches only in explicit retired-input rejection tests.
- [x] Maintained release/API documentation names the replacements. Historical durable `force_close_reason` state remains intact.
- [x] Focused boundary checks pass.

- [x] Focused provider checks pass.
